top_candidates.original_title: Wireblast a 100 Gbps packet generator in Go using AF_XDP
top_candidates.generated_headline: Go and AF_XDP push 100 Gbps packet generation without DPDK cruft
top_candidates.summary: Andree Toonk's Wireblast uses Linux AF_XDP sockets to drive line-rate packet generation in pure Go, bypassing kernel sk_buff overhead to reach 138M pps. stories.generated_headline: A 3KB Solitaire Game Reminds Engineers What Memory Boundaries Look Like

While modern development routinely trades megabytes of overhead for rapid delivery, extreme byte-budgeting forces precise state management at the cost of modern maintainability and hardware flexibility.
